HGS has established processes and systems to record employee grievances through multiple channels, including the HR ticketing system, secure@hgs.com, emails to BPHRs, or written submissions. All complaints are acknowledged, reviewed, and classified as minor, major, or gross. As per the Employee Grievance Redressal Policy, minor issues are addressed by BPHRs within 48 hours, while major or gross misconduct cases are investigated by a designated committee within a defined timeline, typically 10 working days. Findings and decisions are communicated in writing, with an option for the employee to appeal to higher management if dissatisfied.
